title: Prove a 178-incidence P112 bound for the 2²,5,6⁸ C5 caller
body:
Eleven pieces containing six dimensions of the P112 code now require at least **178 support incidences**, raising #3991's uniform floor164 by14. This excludes the different literal historical `(6,5)` caller **2²,5,6⁸**, whose inherited support capacity is176. Its quotient dimension is exactly5 and code-intersection dimension exactly6; the contradiction margin is2.

The new step combines E8/coding theory with incidence geometry of three-planes sharing one two-plane. Two saturated six-root flats with a two-dimensional intersection must share at least two root lines. A bounded exact certificate checks105 relevant Gram patterns and6930 saturated-flat pairs. The exceptional orthogonal two-root kernels are covered by all3780 quotient partitions, each with fiber histogram `{4:6,2:32,1:30}`. Grouping repeated coefficient columns and distinguishing full-root kernel count from live zero coordinates gives support floors178,187,186,185 in the four cases. Rational rank and intersection transfer give arbitrary characteristic-zero fields without an embedding into the reals.

The unchanged PR3154 filter accepts this exact profile. Its preferred five-piece capacity56 blocks the old below53 quotient-basis route. Named predecessor shortening applications also fail their required capacity cutoffs; this is a bounded overlap screen, not a claim of first exclusion or complete historical reconciliation. No full C5 closure, frontier change, constructive algorithm or improvement to selected κ0.001672660197076918 is claimed.

Validation: the registered package passed its exact primary verifier, independent implementation using a fresh root shell/permutation determinants/Fraction elimination/pivot quotients, and controls for repeated columns, full versus live kernel roots, an actual code fixture, and optimized corrupted-receipt rejection. A separate agent independently reviewed scalar extension, candidate closure completeness and all four singleton cases. Human/formal mathematical acceptance remains open.

Credit: #3991 at `e4eb3b7a1334b6fef88fc251c43d9940c8d38de8` supplies the incidence framework; #3269 (Nick Petalas) supplies inherited capacities12/20; #3154 (DreamingOfClouds) supplies the historical caller/filter and generalized-weight premise; David Arias, joaqcoo and the retained E8/P112 lineage supply the root-code model. The frozen predecessor package and sources are unchanged. Chris R / Clear1nsight contributed with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Only `research/p112-saturated-projection-fibers/` is added. The proof separates the unconditional geometric incidence bound from its inherited caller premises. The next obligation is independent acceptance of the argument and those premises; another geometry expansion needs a different exact caller and fresh overlap check.
